# Android

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//android:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//android:defs.bzl", "java_android_library", "kotlin_android_library", "android_native_library")
```

## Rules

### `java_android_library`

```python
java_android_library(**kwargs)
```

Android Java library over rules_android android_library.

### `kotlin_android_library`

```python
kotlin_android_library(**kwargs)
```

Android Kotlin library over rules_kotlin kt_android_library.

### `android_native_library`

```python
android_native_library(name, rust_srcs, c_srcs, hdrs = [], crate_name = None, edition = RUST_EDITION, platforms = None, api_level = 31, crate_features = None, rustc_flags = [], copts = [], linkopts = [], visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Builds one mixed Rust and C shared library per Android tuple.

### `rust_android_apk`

```python
rust_android_apk(name, app_id, deps, platforms = [Label("//android/platforms:arm64-v8a"), Label("//android/platforms:x86_64")], activity = "android.app.NativeActivity", api_level = 0, assets = [], assets_dir = "", custom_package = "", manifest = None, permissions = [], resource_files = [], version_code = 1, version_name = "1.0", visibility = None, tags = None, **kwargs)
```

Packages one APK and one unsigned App Bundle from native CcInfo deps with a Rust entry point.

### `android_apk_set`

Builds the debug-signed split APKs that one App Bundle installs on one device spec.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aab` | `label` | yes | Target that builds the App Bundle. |
| `device_spec` | `label` | yes | bundletool device spec JSON. |
| `_build_apk_set` | `label` | no | Script that runs bundletool build-apks and extract-apks. |
| `_bundletool` | `label` | no | Pinned bundletool. |
| `_java_runtime` | `label` | no |  |
| `_keystore` | `label` | no | Public rules_android debug keystore; debug installs only. |

### `android_check`

```python
android_check(name, package, platforms = [], resources = [], size = "small", tags = None, target_compatible_with = None, visibility = None)
```

Declares a test that the package is an unsigned APK or a valid App Bundle.

### `android_sign`

```python
android_sign(name, package, schemes = None, min_sdk = 0, visibility = None)
```

Declares an explicit release signing launcher for an APK or App Bundle; builds never sign or read keys.

### `android_adb_install`

```python
android_adb_install(name, apk = None, serial = "", apk_set = None, visibility = None)
```

Declares an explicit APK or APK set install launcher; nothing runs at build time.

### `android_adb_start`

```python
android_adb_start(name, app_id, activity = "android.app.NativeActivity", serial = "", visibility = None)
```

Declares an explicit application launch launcher; nothing runs at build time.

### `android_adb_log`

```python
android_adb_log(name, serial = "", visibility = None)
```

Declares an explicit logcat dump launcher; nothing runs at build time.
